## Reproduction

Provide a minimal code example using generated or anonymized rows. Do not attach
private workbooks, credentials, or customer data. Include expected/actual behavior,
error code and stack trace, input size, and whether inline execution also fails.

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately; see SECURITY.md.
